text: The Saby (SBIS) company-registry profile of OOO «Дабл Блэк» (Double Black LLC, Moscow, INN 9715296056) lists Evgeny Kuprin in its owners ('Владельцы') section; Kuprin has been the company's general director since 15 March 2017. The registry masks the share amount and percentage for unauthorised visitors.
short: OOO «Дабл Блэк»'s registry-listed owner is Evgeny Kuprin, its general director
